verdict.rationale: Calendly documents native Salesforce/HubSpot lead-to-owner routing and conversion reporting (calendly-docs-10, -43, -44), plus real-time webhooks and a full REST API for pushing booking data into external systems (calendly-docs-7, -23), which underpins Zapier-style automation. However, no explicit first-party Zapier integration is cited, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming the CRM sync actually eliminates manual copying in practice. Missing for 10: explicit Zapier integration documentation, and independent verification of seamless CRM data flow.
